entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> Unto You I lift up my eyes, O You who dwell in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] to the hand of their masters, As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, So our eyes [look] to the LORD our God, Until He has mercy on us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:3
segments: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us! For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scorn of those who are at ease, With the contempt of the proud.
